tasks.decision: Propose the bounded contract below. W falls within P's declared design adoption for A. B is outside that adoption, while independently applicable common constraints remain binding. A later item's unresolved boundary relation remains unresolved.
tasks.justification: Method inclusion makes a profile available. Product authority owns its durable adoption and frame basis; an exact authorised work instruction activates an actor for a particular evaluation. Individual evaluation obligations follow their applicability predicates, not the availability of a method, frame or actor.

representation.statement: Contract C1 governs design-rule applicability and actor activation for work under Product P's named adoption. It neither asserts completed evaluations nor grants acceptance authority.
premises: The selected method cut includes Design Module Method and an engagement-baseline profile.
P has adopted the named design rule family across boundary A; B is outside that declaration; W changes A.
Design adoption and adoption of an engagement profile are distinct. The supplied facts establish the former, not the latter.

A Product-owned accepted reference-frame basis identifies its authorities, governed scopes, frame and evaluation inventory, actor-binding rules, capabilities, grants, coverage, result relations, activation triggers and invalidation law.
applicability: For work w and rule r, establish both w's relation to the adopted boundary and r's declared conditions. W is within A's adopted scope; this does not automatically make every conditional evaluation applicable.
A supported true applicability predicate requires its evaluation and result. A supported false predicate excludes only that obligation under its owning authority.
For a later item whose relation to A cannot be established, retain unresolved applicability and unresolved required coverage. Do not classify it as outside the boundary.
B is outside this adoption-specific profile scope. Generic design-contract law selected by Spec and all other independently applicable common constraints retain their own applicability.
obligations: Apply the adopted design family consistently across its named boundary, including the affected derivation, modules, execution, construction and projection paths.

Within the adopted family, preserve conditional duties: a new or materially changed semantic boundary requires its accepted Ontology; schema or typed-carrier work requires derived and reconciled IACS; derivation from an existing realisation requires the reference-to-target and Ontology-derived three-view assets; active implementation requires a published module-derived unit test lane before closure.
Bind an activation to an applicable accepted frame declaration or configuration, actor, exact evaluation, subject, basis, evidence boundary, capability envelope and sufficient existing grants.

Carry that activation in a ticket or other authorised work instruction. The Product definition retains the durable shared basis; a temporary activation does not mutate that basis or register a permanent actor/frame assignment.

When the engagement profile is adopted, select direct or coordinated work according to actual dependencies, capability, authority and required independence. Preserve required assessments and reserved owner decisions in either branch.
Retain required results and unresolved applicability in the composite coverage account; assess performance and conformance separately.
exceptions: Partial design adoption is permitted and may narrow scope. The boundary and rule family should be named explicitly, as they are here.
Partial adoption cannot justify design-method completion while omitting evidence needed to audit, refactor or reconstruct the realised boundary.
A sufficiently capable and authorised direct Writer may work without an Executive appointment. A role or frame name creates no additional coordination or review duty.
Profile availability, actor identity and broad frame membership confer no additional semantic, operational, review, acceptance or disposition authority.
result_mapping: W: the declared design-scope applicability is established; individual conditional obligations still depend on their stated predicates.
B: this adoption-specific scope predicate is false. That is an applicability finding, not a conformance judgment or exemption from other law.
Later item with an undecidable boundary relation: applicability is indeterminate; dependent coverage cannot be declared complete.

An authorised activation establishes the execution binding only. Its evaluation result must separately preserve predicate, subject, basis, verdict, performance, original outcome, evidence, effects and residual obligations.
Neither this contract nor a satisfied bounded evaluation constitutes Product acceptance.
residuals: Resolve the later item's boundary relation through sufficient facts and, where necessary, the owning authority.
Supply the concrete accepted frame/profile basis and activation packet before claiming a particular actor evaluation is activated.
The nature of W's change must determine which conditional design duties activate; the statement that W changes A alone does not establish every condition.

sources.quote:
Profile availability, Product adoption, and execution-scoped activation are
three distinct relations.

The Product definition records the
durable shared basis. A ticket or other authorized work instruction carries the
activation packet.

A true predicate requires the applicable evaluation and
result; a false predicate excludes only that obligation under its cited
authority. Missing or ambiguous premises leave applicability unresolved, not
false.

Other applicable constraints remain in force even if only one evaluation detects
them.

Referring to that
law does not adopt the remaining profile: its Ontology, Prime/IACS,
functional-realization, diagram and language policies apply at the design
boundary that adopts them, with their stated conditions and exceptions.

Partial adoption is allowed, but the adopted boundary and adopted rule family
should be named explicitly.

It must not be used to claim design-method completion while skipping the evidence
needed to audit, refactor, or reconstruct the realized boundary.

One capable context with
sufficient work authority, intake and operation grant may enter directly as
Worker (Writer). It needs no Executive activation solely to appoint it.

unknowns: The later item's relation to the adopted boundary is unresolved by stipulation.
The particular engagement-profile adoption, actor, evaluation and work grants are contract parameters, not supplied case facts.
No design-conformance or actor-evaluation outcome for W is supplied.

tasks.decision: Propose a result-handoff contract with an explicit conjunction of availability, fitness and authorised acceptance on X/B. This defines evaluation semantics; it does not assert that X satisfies them.
tasks.justification: The source separates predicate verdict, evaluation performance and observed effects. Required coverage comes from the declared contract, while authenticated counterexamples survive missing assessments. Wrong, stale or unauthenticated contributions cannot silently discharge required slots.

representation.statement: Contract C2 hands off results for Available(X,B), Fit(X,declared_criteria@B), and Accepted(X,B,owner,mandate), and evaluates their conjunction with the declared material joins.
premises: Each contribution binds its producer, exact predicate, subject, governing basis, required-plan membership, supporting evidence and original citations.
The required set contains the three named predicates and their declared material joins; it is not inferred from the returns received.
An acceptance contribution concerns an actual accepted disposition by the mandate-bound authority. A record that some lawful decision occurred is a different predicate.
The consumer declares the criteria, applicability and coverage contract, authentication and currentness requirements, admission conditions, material joins, effect boundary and result consumer.
applicability: Authenticate every contribution for its intended slot on X/B. A result about another subject or basis cannot discharge that slot.

Retain a stale result as historical evidence. Reuse requires an established applicability or preservation relation to the current claim; absent that relation, the current required coverage remains uncovered.
A supported exclusion removes only the obligation its applicability law excludes. Missing evaluation is not evidence of non-applicability.
Distinguish an unusable contribution from an authenticated diagnosis that a required basis is invalid, and distinguish both from an uninterpretable composite subject or basis.
obligations: Preserve predicate, exact subject and basis, verdict, performance, original qualified domain outcome and cause, evidence and citations, unresolved obligations, and material effect observations. Sufficient resolvable references may carry this record.
Use verdicts satisfied, falsified, indeterminate, out_of_frame or invalid_basis. Record performance separately as performed, not_performed or unconfirmed, retaining extent and interruption.

A required evaluation known not to have occurred is not_performed and cannot be satisfied. Separately admissible counterevidence or a supported basis/scope diagnosis may still decide its predicate without inventing execution.
An absent required judgment remains an absent coverage slot with known performance facts or uncertainty; do not fabricate a child result. Dispatch or admission alone proves no performance.

Preserve the original domain outcome and its reason-sensitive mapping. A missing required reason leaves the claimed predicate indeterminate and that contribution inadmissible as deciding support, while retaining independently established findings.
Keep evaluation truth and effects separate. Record all material requested and possible unintended effects on the declared observation boundary; unobserved completion is unknown.

Authenticate and retain component results, failures, coverage gaps, invalidators and effects when producing the aggregate. Applying the combining rule makes the aggregate evaluation performed without changing component performance.
exceptions: The contract requires semantic content, not a new serialization format, document or work carrier.

candidate_ready may establish availability while fitness remains falsified or unassessed. A lawful rejection can satisfy the separate predicate that a mandated decision occurred; it does not establish that X was accepted.

A consumer choosing an operator other than conjunction must declare a different outer predicate with disjoint, exhaustive truth and falsity conditions on its admitted domain. It cannot present disjunction, negation or fallback as satisfaction of all three questions.

Each declared relation has an admission-condition or material-join role in this evaluation. A failed join within an admitted interpretation cannot be relabelled as missing admission merely to conceal the failure.
result_mapping: If the composite subject or governing basis cannot be interpreted, return invalid_basis and expose independently valid component failures.
For an interpretable conjunction, any authenticated applicable falsification of a required predicate or material join makes the result falsified, even alongside a missing required assessment.
With no such falsification: an invalid required basis yields invalid_basis; otherwise a required out-of-frame judgment yields out_of_frame.
Otherwise unresolved applicability, missing assessment, undecidable predicate or undecided material join yields indeterminate.

Satisfied requires authentic satisfaction of every applicable obligation and material join, with coverage established. An empty return list establishes nothing unless the required set is established as empty.
A wrong-subject, wrong-basis or unauthenticated return leaves its intended slot undischarged; it does not erase other valid findings or automatically establish an invalid composite basis.

Normalize effects to current observations of disjoint material parts, preserving identity, ordering and supported supersession. Any unknown part gives an unknown composite effect; other fully observed parts use the source completion/reversal join.
Unknown effects prevent satisfaction when the bound predicate requires their known state. An unrelated effect does not automatically falsify or invalidate a different predicate.
No verdict, availability label or fitness result supplies the owner's acceptance mandate.
residuals: The consumer must fix the exact criteria, required joins, admission interpretation, authentication/currentness rules, authority binding and material effect boundary.
Acquire missing current assessments and effect observations, or retain their uncovered slots and uncertainty.
Preserve raw outcomes and causes through every projection; the aggregate summary does not replace component evidence.

sources.quote: A result makes a claim about one predicate on one subject and basis.

A missing required judgment stays an absent coverage slot, with the known
performance fact or its uncertainty; it is not a fabricated child result.

Candidate availability, candidate fitness and authorised acceptance are three
predicates.

Requested or material possible unintended effects without sufficient observation
are unknown, never defaulted to not_requested.

First authenticate each contribution against its producer, subject, basis and
required plan membership. An unauthenticated claim cannot discharge an
obligation.

Any authenticated, applicable falsification of a required predicate or material join makes
   the conjunction `falsified`.

`satisfied` requires every applicable obligation and material join to be
   authentically satisfied, with coverage itself established.

The original
record keeps its original subject; an applicability relation permits its use
for the new claim.

unknowns: No actual availability, fitness or acceptance results for X/B are supplied.
The concrete criteria, mandate, joins, currentness evidence and effect observations remain parameters of the proposed contract.

tasks.decision: Reuse A through its established applicability relation; reassess B; do not justify excluding C from an incomplete dependency view; run the independently mandatory G. Reject the claimed 99% probability of Product correctness. For the bounded assurance-completion claim: P is satisfied, F is falsified, and U is indeterminate.
tasks.justification: A has the stipulated supported preservation relation across assertion, execution and reliance dependencies. B executes the changed library, while C's absent dependency path has incomplete coverage. The suites share material assertion and observation dependencies, so different model families do not establish statistical independence. The conjunction law preserves both complete positive support and a decisive failure alongside uncovered coverage.

representation.statement: Evaluate evidence reuse and the predicate H: all fixed required assurance obligations and material joins for the L change on S1/B1 are supported.
premises: The historical passes of A, B and C concern S0/B0.
A's material assertion, execution and reliance dependencies are covered and unaffected, and its applicability-preservation relation to S1/B1 is established.
B executes L. C's dependency view has no L path but lacks complete material dependency coverage.
The two suites share an implementation-derived expected-output generator and old input observations despite different model families.
applicability: A: retain the historical record on S0/B0 and use the established relation to support the current claim on S1/B1.
B: the changed library is a material execution dependency, so select B for current reassessment; its old pass alone does not support the new claim.
C: exclusion is unsupported. Acquire sufficient dependency coverage and a preservation justification, or widen current assessment; otherwise its assurance remains unresolved.
G: change-based selection does not remove its independent applicability.
obligations: Construct the current evidence account from applicable retained records plus actual reassessment, new obligations and mandatory gates.
Keep known failures and unresolved coverage visible. Selection and dispatch produce no execution evidence.
Separate assertion provenance from execution provenance. The shared expected-output derivation and observations must remain in the suites' dependence account.
Any numerical assurance claim must supply a justified uncertainty model, priors, likelihoods, shared causes and calibration limits.
exceptions: A fresh run of every old check is unnecessary when supported retention establishes current applicability, as it does for A.
Full-suite execution is available but does not itself establish complete coverage or waive mandatory gates.
The agreeing suites can retain justified local or regression evidence; their agreement does not independently validate their common expected-output model.
result_mapping: Manager's claim: unsupported. Multiplying 0.1 by 0.1 requires the relevant conditional independence, which different model families do not establish and the shared causes require evaluating.

Even if a justified model yielded a 0.01 joint miss probability, 0.99 would describe at least one detection conditional on the specified violation and model, not a 99% posterior probability that the Product is correct.

P: satisfied for H. B and C have valid current passing evidence, G passes, A's applicability is established, and every fixed required obligation and material join has valid support. No further gap is invented.
F: falsified for H. B's admissible counterexample defeats a required predicate. C's missing current return remains explicit and does not weaken that supported failure into mere uncertainty.

U: indeterminate for H. B and G pass and no counterexample is present, but C's dispatch receipt supplies neither a current conclusion nor established evaluation performance. C remains an absent required slot with unconfirmed performance.
P establishes bounded assurance completeness. It does not establish universal Product correctness or constitute an authorised Product acceptance or release decision.
residuals: Initially acquire B's current reassessment, resolve C's coverage/current evidence, and satisfy G.
In F, retain B's counterexample until supported repair, reassessment or authorised obligation change disposes it; C's missing assessment remains outstanding.
In U, acquire C's authenticated current return and any evidence required to resolve its contribution. A dispatch receipt cannot replace it.
A quantitative probability of Product correctness requires additional justified modelling and evidence; it cannot be recovered from the two nominal miss rates alone.

sources.quote:
Excluding a check requires supported dependency coverage and a reason the change
cannot invalidate the reused claim. An absent edge proves no non-influence.

New obligations and uncovered cases create assessment work even when no existing
check covers them; mandatory gates remain applicable. Selection itself produces
no execution evidence.

Retention establishes that claim and scope still apply, assertion and observation
bases remain justified, required independence holds, and material dependencies
are unchanged or covered by an established preservation relation.

Different actors, families or
codebases do not establish statistical independence. Repeating an observation
does not make it new independent evidence

One minus the joint miss probability is the
chance of at least one detection under those conditions, not the probability
that the whole product is correct.

Any authenticated, applicable falsification of a required predicate or material join makes
   the conjunction `falsified`. Missing or undecidable other coverage remains
   explicit alongside it.

`satisfied` requires every applicable obligation and material join to be
   authentically satisfied, with coverage itself established.

An absent return establishes neither non-performance nor an
undecidable evaluation: retain the missing slot and what is actually known.

unknowns: Before the followups, C's supported exclusion or current assessment remains unresolved, and B and G still require current evidence.
F retains C's missing current assessment; U retains C's unconfirmed performance and absent conclusion.
P has no remaining assurance gap within the stipulated fixed obligations and joins.
The supplied facts support no numerical posterior probability of Product correctness.

tasks.decision: The present design-method-completion declaration is falsified by two established unmet obligations. Variant P supports satisfied bounded design completion. Variant U leaves applicability and the resulting completion claim indeterminate pending authority resolution. None of these findings constitutes Product acceptance or a release decision.
tasks.justification: The adopted boundary is materially changed, derives from an existing realisation and has active implementation. Design §15 therefore requires publication of the reference-to-target derivation asset and a module-derived unit test lane. Helper-level tests do not supply the required ownership-based proof. The stipulated Ontology, IACS, three-view assets and other adequate criteria remain credited.

representation.statement: Evaluate the bounded claim D: W is design-method complete under the applicable adopted design law and current basis.
premises: The present adoption covers service A and its active implementation. W materially changes A's typed schema and derives from an existing realisation.
The accepted Ontology is complete for the material change, including admitted atom domains and projection traceability.
IACS is derived and reconciled, and Ontology-derived domain, sequence and state assets are published.
The reference-to-target derivation asset is unpublished; only helper-level tests exist, with no published module-derived unit test lane.
All other applicable criteria for this bounded gate have adequate current evidence.
applicability: The material adopted semantic/schema change activates the Ontology and IACS requirements, which the supplied facts satisfy.
Derivation from an existing realisation activates the reference-to-target and Ontology-derived three-view publication requirements.
Active implementation activates publication of a module-derived unit test lane before closure.
In U, the old adoption boundary's application to the changed service cannot be established. This is unresolved applicability, not a supported exclusion.
obligations: Publish the reference-to-target derivation asset and establish its applicable criteria on the current basis.
Publish a justified unit test lane derived from the governing Ontology and module ownership; helper-layout coverage alone is insufficient.
Conjoin the actual required design predicates and material joins. A returned representation's silence cannot remove a requirement stated by its exact owning source.
Preserve conformance and the design authority's decision as separate predicates, and preserve Product and release decisions under their own authority.
exceptions: Implementation-discovered tests are permissible, but closure proof must be re-expressed against module ownership.
Partial adoption may narrow scope; it cannot support completion while omitting the evidence needed to reconstruct the adopted realised boundary.
The unchanged-boundary reuse exception does not apply to the stipulated material typed-schema change.
Any permission for provisional co-evolution depends on its own admissibility condition and does not itself establish promotion or closure.
result_mapping: Present: D is falsified. The two applicable publication requirements are known unmet conditions, not merely unexamined evidence. Withhold the proposed completion declaration.

P: D is satisfied for the bounded gate. The missing reference-to-target asset and justified module-derived test lane are published on the current basis with their criteria established, and the stipulated support for all other applicable criteria completes the required conjunction.

U: D is indeterminate because application of the adopted design boundary is unresolved and no authority resolution exists. Retain the known publication facts without asserting either a supported exemption or a proved invalid governing basis.
U requires a supported applicability determination or lawful authority resolution of the adoption basis; the evaluator cannot silently enlarge or replace that boundary.
The present failure prevents this design-completion claim; P establishes this bounded completion claim; U establishes neither completion nor non-applicability.
No branch supplies Product acceptance, release eligibility, exact-cut acceptance, selector promotion, installation or rollout authority.
residuals: Present: supply the two missing artifacts with their required current evidence.
P: no additional defect is inferred in the stipulated bounded gate.
U: resolve the adoption-to-service relation through its existing authority while retaining independently applicable common obligations.
A returned representation is bounded evidence about the method; its omission of an obligation cannot override the exact owning specification.

sources.quote:
When the new or materially changed boundary is derived from an existing
realization, the project must also publish the reference-to-target derivation
asset and the Ontology-derived three-view design asset before claiming
design-method completion for the changed boundary.

When the new or materially changed boundary has active implementation, the
project must also publish a module-derived unit test lane before claiming
closure for that change.

Unit tests may be discovered from implementation behavior, but the closure proof
must be re-expressed against module ownership rather than code helper shape.

No view count, empty set or supported exclusion
substitutes for the required assessment coverage.

The design authority separately records its
`accepted` or `non-accepted` decision.

Missing or ambiguous premises leave applicability unresolved, not
false.

The required set comes from the composite's applicability and coverage
contract, not from the list of returns received.

`RELEASE_METHOD.md` governs release-cut, Product, install, qualification, and
  version-line promotion evaluation

unknowns: U leaves the adoption record's applicability to changed service A unresolved until its authority supplies a supported resolution.
No further Ontology, IACS, three-view or other bounded-gate deficiency is inferred from the supplied facts.
No separate Product acceptance or release decision is supplied.

limitations: Scope is the frozen codex RC1 end-review repair candidate: package d1b33480b46f45bb46198a2f63ca197e84e40e55 at checkpoint 8884178770672c933aef706947a864ab6422e1c6.
These are fresh bounded semantic contracts and applications, not a full native a_c program, whole-method reconstruction or candidate-wide conformance assessment.
The authored native interpretation remains proposed. Exact owning specification text governs these conclusions; representation coverage and omissions establish neither completeness nor exemptions.

The stipulated scenario facts are treated as facts. Satisfaction is limited to each named predicate, subject, basis and required coverage; these outputs confer no acceptance, mutation or release authority.
